spans.s: गौड (I) m. 1. Name of a country. (Its situation is thus described- वंगदेशं समारभ्य भुवनेशांतगः शिवो गौडदेशः समाख्यायः सर्वविद्याविशारदः); 2. a particular subdivision of Brāhmaṇas.
गौड (II) m. pl. The inhabitants of Gauḍa.

गौडी f. 1. Spirit distilled from molasses, गौडी पैष्ठी च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा । यथैवैका तथा सर्वा न पातव्या द्विजोत्तमैः M.xi.94; 2. one of the styles of poetic composition. [Their number varies according to different writers on rhetoric. Mammata mentions three, Viśvanātha four. The Gauḍī style is thus defined in the K.Pr.- ओजःप्रकाशकैस्तैः (वर्णैः) तु परुषा (i.e. गौडी)].
